description: Keep related repositories and their chats together in one project space. Start common or project chats, move or copy threads, and track questions, failures and finished work in the sidebar. Add shared materials with ai-workspace and code queries across repositories with Repowise; both require separate optional CLIs. Requires BB 0.49+; the interface is Russian, and ai-workspace installation downloads verified binaries from GitHub. Chats use your configured agent account or quota.
